set.n: Peter Morekoontz' house on the Lake Pepin shore (plat: "P. Marchand's"), 1849 GLO survey
set.pl: Sec. 20 T23N R15W, 1.00 ch south of the sec. 17/20 line and 51.62 ch west of the 16/17/20/21 corner (1849 GLO field notes)
pinev: 1849 interior field notes, west corrected line between secs. 17 and 20: at 51.62 ch "Peter Morekoontz' house 100 links South of line"; placed by chaining from the BLM PLSS section corner (about 50 m).
The 1848-49 plat marks the same spot as "P. Marchand's".

glo-pepin-marchand-1848.st: The 1849 field notes name the man: on the west corrected line between secs. 17 and 20, at 51.62 chains, the surveyor (Farnham) wrote "Peter Morekoontz' house 100 links South of line", and a pond lies at 68 to 76 chains. The plat's "P. Marchand's" is a mis-copy of this name. The pin now sits at the chained spot in sec. 20. Two survey records (plat and field notes) now agree.
src: GLO interior field notes T23N R15W, Wisconsin (1849, Farnham), west corrected line secs. 17/20, UW Digital Collections

pinev: 1849 interior field notes, line between secs. 22 and 23: at 58.50 ch "Road, bears West, HOUSE 4 chains East of line"; at 59.36 ch "Enter McKean's farm". Placed 58.50 ch south of the 14/15/22/23 corner and 4.00 ch east, from the BLM PLSS corner (about 50 m).

cd-lakeport-mccain-1846.st: The 1849 field notes pin the house down: on the line between secs. 22 and 23, at 58.50 chains, a road bears west and the "HOUSE" stands 4 chains east of the line, and at 59.36 chains the line enters "McKean's farm". The pin now sits at that spot in sec. 23, on the old road.
src: GLO interior field notes T23N R15W, Wisconsin (1849, Farnham), line secs. 22/23, UW Digital Collections
